scope: Relative adaptation-manifest asset resolution in DiffSynth VACE training preflight
summary: The first remote training preflight exposed that frozen relative asset paths were resolved against the process working directory; the loader now resolves them against the manifest directory and the focused CPU tests pass.
evidence: The first invocation failed before GPU model loading because Path(asset[path]) used the process working directory.
phiagent/training/diffsynth_animate.py now resolves relative frozen-manifest paths from manifest_path.parent before validating assets.
The focused build/train/inference suite passes 9 tests after the patch; the evaluator suite passes 2 additional tests.

The corrected rank-4 smoke run completed 24/24 optimizer steps on physical A800 GPU 6 and produced a 5,503,040-byte checkpoint with SHA-256 72fae3209d4400a08e157032cf8d436aed9a621f80725a9aad36c960b76bb2e2.
lessons: Frozen manifests must remain portable across local and remote roots, so all relative assets need one documented resolution base.
limitations: The successful smoke training proves trainability only, not heldout viewpoint quality.
next_actions: Keep the relative-path regression tests in the CPU-only suite.
